scores.reason: Muon physics (g-2 anomalous magnetic moment measurement). Off-topic; no relevance to neural network batch size scaling.

Directly addresses critical batch size (CBS) scaling with comprehensive sweeps of batch size, momentum, learning rate, and fitting scaling laws. However, experiments only on large-scale LLM pretraining (85M-1.2B on C4), not short-horizon or small-data regime (CIFAR-scale ≤2000 steps). Lacks concrete scaling rules for specific hyperparameters and no accuracy-recovery tricks. Meets rubric criterion 1 partially.

Proposes concrete scaling rule for Adam hyperparameters with batch size (fixing half-life in tokens rather than steps), addressing criterion 2. Studies batches down to size 1 and claims equal/better per-FLOP performance. However, applied to LLM training on large datasets, not small-data regime; addresses Adam not Muon; focuses on small-batch stability rather than large-batch accuracy recovery. Meets rubric criterion 2 partially.

Title directly targets critical batch size for Muon optimizer. Provides theoretical convergence proofs and derives lower bound on Muon CBS, directly addressing question (2). However, abstract does not confirm small-scale experiments (CIFAR-like, ≤2000 steps) or concrete hyperparameter scaling rules. Meets rubric criterion 1; unclear on 2, 3, 4.
